title: SessionHandoff
description: A strictly machine-readable handoff format that preserves project context, evidence, and safe continuation instructions between Courier sessions.

project_identity.description: The resolved canonical project name (e.g., Courier Symphony).

current_gate.description: The current shipping gate or boundary (e.g., REAL_CODING_E2E_CLEAN_VERIFIED).

current_sha.description: The exact commit SHA at the moment of handoff.

completed_work.description: List of task keys or IDs completed during this session.

accepted_evidence.description: Pointers to the verification artifacts produced.

active_writers.description: Identities or processes currently holding write locks.

dirty_worktrees.description: Files or paths currently modified but not committed.

human_decisions.description: Decisions explicitly made by a human user during this session.

next_executable_work.description: The immediate next steps or task IDs to be executed.

artifacts.description: Paths or URIs to files generated during the session.

safe_continuation_instructions.description: Specific context required for the next agent to resume safely without repeating work.
